Hi Alex — quick unit-econ note based on the setup we discussed:

- Recommended model/config: open-variant v2.1 quantized (recommended tradeoff for ACME pilot).
- Typical token composition we observed from your sample: prompt ~35% / completion ~65%.
- Expected cost (hosted API, no committed discounted tier): ~$0.0010 per token equivalent -> ~$1,000 per 1M tokens.
- With simple batching (100ms batching window) + KV prefix caching for search hits, we commonly hit ~15– 25% effective cost reduction for repeated prefixes. For a pilot with caching patterns, realistic delivered cost could be ~$800–$900 per 1M tokens.
- If Acme is comfortable with dedicated capacity or annual commit, we can drop unit cost further (to ~$400–$600 per 1M) — happy to include that in a commercial proposal.

Regarding credits: if runway target is 3 weeks at 20M tokens/week (~60M tokens), at $1,000/1M that’s ~$60k list value. We can approve a $10k credit extension for the pilot today to cover initial ramp, with the option to revisit if usage spikes toward the 60M/month estimate.

I’ve attached a quick pricing breakdown (redwood_pricing_breakdown.xlsx) and included recommended runtime flags to keep p50 latency <150ms.

—Rishi
